result.title: Beyond Raw Similarity: Prior-Aware Fusion for Out-of-Distribution Detection
result.summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in vision-language models presents unique challenges due to the reliance on cross-modal similarity. Even when embeddings are well separated for in-distribution (ID) data, similarity scores can remain overconfident for OOD inputs. A common remedy is to adapt the model on ID data, but adaptation discards the pretrained geometry that made the similarity meaningful. We propose multi-modal logit fusion (MM-Log), which keeps both by pairing a gradient-free zero-shot prior with a task-adapted branch in each modality and fuses their four cross-modal similarity channels into a single OOD score. Because the zero-shot priors are never adapted, the cross-channels act as a consistency check between the pretrained and adapted geometries: an OOD input that fools the adapted branch through a shortcut must additionally agree with frozen CLIP to retain a high score. We formalize this as a margin bound showing that the fused score is provably penalized by disagreement between the zero-shot and adapted branches, a signal to which adapted-only scores are structurally blind. MM-Log requires no auxiliary OOD data, negative prompts, or test-time adaptation, and trains on few-shot ID data alone. Across Far-OOD, Near-OOD, and Hard-OOD benchmarks, MM-Log consistently outperforms strong CLIP-based baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对视觉语言模型中的 OOD 检测，提出 MM-Log：在每个模态中同时保留冻结的零样本 CLIP 先验与任务适配分支，将四路跨模态相似度通道融合为单一 OOD 分数，并用 margin bound 说明零样本与适配分支的不一致会惩罚融合分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“冻结先验与适配分支一致性校验”及跨通道相似度融合，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度受几何漂移影响、以及依据内部状态可靠性做停止或证据筛选提供方法线索，需核查其分数校准方式是否可迁移。
